**Outcome and scope**

Found a fresh network with the seven shared foundations through existing bootstrap/enrollment machinery. Implement clean Godot identity creation/unlock, authenticated transport, user/personal-agent provisioning and the portable GUI adapter together with the consolidated Prolog composition. Render offered controls, nested forms, questions and validation errors from the model; use existing U→A signed operations rather than a hardcoded client workflow.

**Acceptance**

- [ ] A fresh account reaches a usable GUI; an existing local identity unlocks and reconnects with exact U/A identities and no duplicate provisioning.

- [ ] M1a: execute the reproducible seven-foundation recipe from clean local genesis; prove signup composition, absence of the old mandatory shared lobby foundation and privacy of receipts/account state through production seams.

- [ ] M1b: the clean Godot client operates that generic GUI through U→A, including keyboard/mouse, cancellation, invalid input, reconnect and active-key/backup behavior qualified in M0.

- [ ] M1a provisions exactly the original distinct U/A and ordinary parentless S0, with A initially placed inside it, explicit authorized storage and private receipt/account handling; denial/uncertain replies/recovery do not duplicate provisioning. ### Current M1a implementation

Worker session `922c7c06-1acb-4c2b-9141-fccf4ab4c947` is implementing only M1a in `worktree/pearl-stone`, HEAD `d027f9f65bbce2f484f906c92bf07ebaa4669c38`. All 778 verified M0 snapshot source entries matched the starting tree. The worker made no commit/reset/main import. Actual session model is `openai-codex:gpt-6.1-sol`; high was requested, and effective reasoning effort is not exposed by the session summary.

The focused production campaign19 passed: root plus six unique catalogue identities, actual enrollment, two separate U/A/S0 sets, atomic private setup with committed permission-withdrawal and pin refusals, basic two-human privacy, signed gui_hud/gui_operations, Save/Reset, stale revision/typed input refusals, unchanged retained views, fresh-session original-result recovery, HTTPS complete public source/private denial, and Prolog/outcome-owner restart without constructor generation. Real anchors, source order/hashes, compiled predicate profiles, instance counts and public TLS/hostname/network receipts are under [M1a evidence](/home/yan/src/quod_worktrees/pearl-stone/doc/evidence/godot-m1a-20261027/focused-foundations-19-founding.json). True child exit is 0. This focused result is not clean final gate qualification. Development failures and the interrupted/stale-beam attempts are retained and separately explained.

Foreign-storage/part rollback, expanded privacy and revocation, full restart, source retirement/caller migration and final clean sequential gates remain in progress. No broader acceptance is checked prematurely. Yan's subsequent instruction, “have implementation reviewed by Claude,” authorizes one new consultative Claude Fable implementation review after a frozen review input is prepared. The old consumed M0 authorization is not reused. M1b Godot interaction and all full-M1/client-dependent checks remain open; no desktop/XR/Vive claim is made. No automatic next milestone or commit is authorized.

The installed session-link response reports linked with linkedCount 0; that UI limitation is retained, not treated as visible attribution to another session.


### Authorized implementation review and follow-through

Yan's request has been fulfilled by one read-only Claude Fable review,
session `a2cdb043-2e69-4b70-8f0e-2362b74b65da`, on immutable snapshot
`/tmp/quod-godot-m1a-review-922c7c06-20261027-01` (snapshot.json SHA-256
`39037144d03150dac922a59712827dc7ed724a2c6ebf021229ce5f34dcee6fc0`).
The full report and checked dispositions are retained in
[checked review](/home/yan/src/quod_worktrees/pearl-stone/doc/evidence/godot-m1a-20261027/checked-fable-review.md).
This review authorization is consumed. The worker independently reproduced
arbitrary-key setup acceptance through signed production setup (wrong-key-03).
The existing preparation bridge now offers a signed immutable custody receipt;
setup verifies supplied bytes against its proof-bound executor without a live
vault lookup. Focused validation is underway. Initial occupants explicitly
refuse cross-history participants; mandatory same-storage S0 and ordinary
foreign-storage construction retain existing machinery.

M2/M3 policy obligation within the existing milestone chain: completed S0's
current grants do not authorize later instance admission or A entry. Those
milestones must author and qualify ordinary Prolog create/entry/admission
policy. No additional runtime executor or M1a scope expansion is implied.
Post-review qualification and clean final gates remain pending; full M1 and
M1b-dependent checks remain open.


### Clean qualification campaign01

The worker's frozen clean campaign01 passed native56, then completed 4,251
EUnit tests with 31 failures (true exit1, no timeout, authored source unchanged).
CT/xref/Dialyzer/release remain explicitly unrun. The current-source M1a signed
journey passed within that run, including all eleven history profiles, two
U/A/S0 sets, privacy/Save/Reset, final acknowledgement rollback and original-key
restart. Its fifteen source hashes match the current production ontologies.

Failures are retained in the [campaign result](/home/yan/src/quod_worktrees/pearl-stone/doc/evidence/godot-m1a-20261027/gates-01-result.json)
and [failure index](/home/yan/src/quod_worktrees/pearl-stone/doc/evidence/godot-m1a-20261027/inputs/gates-01-failure-index.json).
The demonstrated gaps are fixture migrations: merged GUI owner/ACL composition,
user source installation at genesis, collision with production space offers,
physical-fixture source descriptors/hosting/reference recovery, and an old
Prolog catalogue name in the HTTPS client. The first corrected batch passes all
24 GUI/ACL/space cases. Physics-view and physical lifecycle checks are running
sequentially before a fresh clean campaign. Production runtime/common sources
are unchanged since campaign01. No deadline, assertion or dependency is weakened.

The single requested Fable review is complete and consumed. Final M1a and all
M1b/full-M1 acceptance remain open pending the required qualification boundary.
No commit, next checkpoint, deployment or additional review is started.
